title: Validate SDK registry state, provenance, and OIDC readiness
description: Verify the published fixed group and preserve evidence that future releases can use the protected OIDC path.
acceptance_criteria: Versions, latest dist-tags, manifests, licenses, changelogs, binaries, internal ranges, checksums, npm provenance, GitHub attestations, and clean consumer imports all match the release record.

title: Configure trusted publishing for SDK release packages
description: Bind the four 0.1 release packages to OpenCoven/sdk, the exact release workflow, and the protected npm-release environment. The private CLI is excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the four release packages has the expected trusted-publisher identity; @opencoven/dev-cli has none; normal workflow publication uses OIDC; NPM_TOKEN and NODE_AUTH_TOKEN fallback remain absent.

title: Perform the one-time SDK npm bootstrap publication
description: Publish the exact verified tarballs in canonical order with an explicitly approved least-privilege bootstrap credential, then revoke it.
design: This external mutation requires fresh explicit authorization at execution time even after its dependency chain is clear.
acceptance_criteria: All four release package records and expected versions exist; bytes and ownership match the verified artifacts; @opencoven/dev-cli is absent; the credential is revoked; no token is stored in GitHub, repository files, or shell history; the audit trail is recorded.

title: Tag the reviewed commit and run verify-mode artifacts
description: Create the annotated sdk-v<version> tag from the exact reviewed main commit and run release workflow verify mode without publishing.
acceptance_criteria: The tag resolves to reviewed HEAD; four tarballs, release-manifest.json, checksums, and attestations are retained; every digest and package contract passes; @opencoven/dev-cli is absent; registry state is unchanged.

title: Prepare the reviewed SDK launch and publication-unlock change
description: Prepare a reviewed release branch that versions the fixed group, updates changelogs and internal ranges, opens repository publication locks, and preserves the protected environment gate.
design: Use Changesets and the existing release contract. Do not create credentials, tags, or registry records in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical verification passes in a clean checkout; version and ranges are exact; publish mode still requires the protected environment; a PR is reviewed and merged without direct push to main.

title: Complete the first-release security review
description: Review package APIs, release scripts and workflows, dependency findings, secret handling, provenance, and the documented experimental boundary before publication unlock.
design: Treat current zero CodeQL and Dependabot alerts as inputs, not a substitute for release-scope review.
acceptance_criteria: The review records scope, threat boundaries, automated and manual evidence, all findings with disposition, and an explicit ship or block recommendation.

title: Reconcile SDK release governance prerequisites
description: Confirm npm ownership, account 2FA, package bootstrap constraints, protected npm-release environment, required checks, and the current branch-protection constraint before unlock.
design: RELEASING.md requires a protected npm-release environment. Prior maintainer direction leaves branch protection untouched unless separately authorized.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence covers npm organization and package-name readiness, least-privilege bootstrap ownership, protected environment reviewers, required checks, and an explicit decision about branch protection. No branch protection or environment is changed without separate approval.

title: Authorize the first SDK release and target version
description: Decide whether the experimental SDK is approved to publish and define the exact fixed-group version and release scope.
design: Current state is version 0.1.0, publishingEnabled false, four release packages private, and @opencoven/dev-cli private outside the fixed group. Preserve those locks unless this decision explicitly authorizes a reviewed launch change.
acceptance_criteria: A maintainer records approve or defer, target version, included package scope, launch criteria, and explicit authority to begin external release preparation. No publication occurs in this decision.

title: Ship the first public OpenCoven SDK release
description: Execute the separately authorized first release using the landed two-key release system, exact verified artifacts, one-time bootstrap, trusted publishing, and provenance validation.
acceptance_criteria: All gated children close with authorization and audit evidence; four fixed-version release packages are validated in the registry; @opencoven/dev-cli remains unpublished; future publishing uses protected OIDC only.

title: Land the two-key locked release system
description: Historical record for PRs #14, #22, and #23: release design, implementation, independent review fixes, hosted verification, and completion documentation.
acceptance_criteria: The release system is merged, publishingEnabled remains false, packages remain private, and the current verifier enforces release contracts.
notes: Release implementation merged as 35b67b7; completion documentation landed in PR #23.
close_reason: Release-readiness controls landed through PRs #14, #22, and #23; publication remains intentionally locked.

title: Build the locked SDK release-readiness system
description: Historical delivery epic for fixed versioning, fail-closed publication, checksummed artifacts, Node support gates, protected workflow identity, policies, and packed release verification.
acceptance_criteria: Release controls and subsequent maintenance are closed with merge evidence while publishing remains intentionally disabled.
close_reason: The locked release-readiness mechanism is delivered; actual first publication is tracked separately.

title: Reconcile and mature the Phase 0 SDK
description: Historical record for PRs #9-#13: reconcile independent implementation lines, mature package boundaries, make the clean-install matrix safe, add Cave familiar analytics, and harden runtime operations.
acceptance_criteria: PRs #9-#13 are merged, their guarantees remain on current main, and historical Cave task references are not recreated as open SDK work.
notes: Historical cross-repository references: cave-o2bqs and cave-u0oli. SDK delivery continued through PRs #9, #10, #11, #12, and #13.
close_reason: Completed through merged PRs #9-#13; historical Cave references are delivery evidence, not open SDK work.

title: Land the SDK foundation and security safeguards
description: Historical record for PRs #1-#8: initial SDK packages, licenses, CI repair, experimental warning, leak prevention, publication lock, and safeguards completion record.
acceptance_criteria: PRs #1-#8 are merged or intentionally superseded, required merge commits are ancestors of main, and security/release gates remain represented in current source.
notes: Primary merges: PR #1 33091b7; PR #2 72888c2; PR #7 2291002; PR #8 a1c24d2.
close_reason: Completed through merged PRs #1-#8; merge evidence remains on current main.

title: Deliver the SDK Phase 0 foundation
description: Historical delivery epic for the public TypeScript SDK foundation, security safeguards, reconciliation, maturity, Cave analytics, and runtime hardening.
acceptance_criteria: All child delivery records are closed with merged PR and current-main ancestry evidence.
close_reason: Phase 0 foundation, safeguards, reconciliation, and maturity are delivered on main.

title: Define the operational opencoven CLI scope
description: Resolve whether @opencoven/dev-cli belongs in the SDK 0.1 public release and assign production native trust ownership without weakening fail-closed behavior.
design: Decision: keep @opencoven/dev-cli as a private source-tested workspace outside the four-package 0.1 release group. Chat Tauri owns Phase 1 native Cave path and Coven peer/pipe adapters. Any future standalone CLI release requires a separately reviewed native distribution design.
acceptance_criteria: The four-package public inventory is enforced across release config, Changesets, artifacts, publishing, tests, and docs; CLI source/keyring/security contracts remain tested; Chat #27 owns Phase 1 adapters; future CLI publication requires separate review.
notes:
Implementation branch: release/defer-dev-cli-v0.1. SDK issue: https://github.com/OpenCoven/sdk/issues/37.
Focused matrix passed: 9 files / 101 tests. Canonical corepack pnpm@10.34.0 verify passed: 45 files / 1024 tests, coverage, three stress seeds, and lint.

title: Reconcile completed SDK plan checklists
description: The Phase 0 reconciliation and release-readiness plans contain unchecked execution steps despite merged completion evidence, making historical text look like active work.
design: Audit the plans against PRs #9, #11, #22, and #23 plus current main. Update documentation only; do not rewrite history or claim unverified red-green steps.
acceptance_criteria: Both plans have explicit completed and merged status; checkboxes are reconciled only with PR and commit evidence; no unchecked line looks actionable; deliberately unperformed external release operations remain explicit.

title: Complete dependency and workflow maintenance through PR #27
description: Historical record for merged dependency and workflow-action maintenance in PRs #15-#21 and #24-#27, including support-matrix pin repairs.
acceptance_criteria: All referenced PRs are merged, latest main checks pass, and no open Dependabot or CodeQL alert remains.
close_reason: Dependency and action maintenance through PR #27 is merged and green on main.

title: Retire approved superseded branches, worktrees, and stash state
description: Remove only repository state proven superseded by the audit and explicitly approved by the maintainer.
acceptance_criteria: Approval is recorded; exact targets are enumerated; recoverability is documented; approved targets are removed; retained targets and the canonical checkout remain clean.
notes: Destructive cleanup is not authorized by creating this Bead.

title: Audit legacy branches, worktrees, and the preserved stash
description: Classify every attached worktree, local and remote branch, and stash@{0} as merged, patch-equivalent, superseded, unique, or still needed.
acceptance_criteria: The audit records exact refs, ancestry or patch-equivalence proof, dirty state, stash comparison, and a proposed keep or retire disposition for every item. No state is deleted.

title: Retire superseded SDK repository state safely
description: Audit and, only after approval, retire legacy SDK branches, worktrees, and the preserved reconciliation stash without losing unique work.
acceptance_criteria: Every state item has evidence-backed disposition; only approved strict supersets or merged state are removed; the canonical checkout remains clean.
